name: Kergans
description: Kergans was a urban planet located in the Kergans system within the Inner Rim Territories that was protected by the New Republic. It was the homeworld of Lorica Demaris. A hotel owned by Lorica's mother and father was located on Kergans. At some point before joining the Resistance, Lorica watched podracing on her homeworld.
